name: search_catalog
description: Find canonical company, variety or country IDs using authored catalog names and aliases. Results include exact_name, exact_alias or substring match basis. A unique exact match can resolve the requested name; multiple exact matches remain ambiguous and must not be guessed. Bounded results preserve exact matches first and disclose truncation. Matching does not approve an identity or claim.
